content: Canonical fixed-timestep render smoothing (Gaffer): accumulator consumes frame time in fixed STEP chunks with 0.25s clamp; keep previous and current sim state, alpha = accumulator/STEP, render lerp(prev,curr,alpha). For values wrapping mod 1 (like rope phase in [0,1)), use shortest-path delta (if d>0.5 subtract 1) before lerping to avoid wrap-snap glitches.
